4.9 stars. 164 reviews. At a pastry café inside Sunset Town.

Cafe Juliet & Pastries sits right in the Venice quarter of Phú Quốc's most photogenic district. The kind of place that earns a near-perfect score and still surprises you when you walk in.

Budget $15-30 per person. Worth every dong.
